name: cv-tailor-ai
description: Mobile-first app that tailors a master CV to a job description and exports an ATS-friendly PDF.

scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.lint: eslint client/src client/vite.config.ts server/src server/tests server/scripts server/vitest.config.ts --max-warnings 0
